plugin.name: Super Folder Lock
window.title: Super Folder Lock
window.keys: ↑↓ folder · enter open/view · l lock · L lock all · c password · e edit · n new · , settings · esc
error.gocryptfs.missing: gocryptfs is not installed: run omarchy pkg add gocryptfs
error.registry.broken: The folder registry is damaged; it was not overwritten
error.folder.unknown: That folder is no longer registered
error.path.notEmpty: Something is already at that path; it was not opened
error.path.parentMissing: The parent folder no longer exists
error.mount.failed: The folder could not be opened
error.lock.failed: The folder could not be locked; close what is using it and try again
form.createHint: Choose the folder to lock. It can already have files.
form.name: Name in the list
form.warning: If you forget the password and lose the recovery key, the files cannot be recovered.
form.keys: tab next field · enter create · esc back
error.key.short: The password needs at least 5 characters
error.path.outsideHome: It must be inside your home folder or a connected disk (no links)
error.init.failed: The folder could not be created
recovery.title: «%1» is ready — recovery key
recovery.hint: Keep this key somewhere safe. It opens the folder if you forget its password. It is shown only now and is not stored anywhere.
gate.hint: Type your user password to see your protected folders
gate.locked: Too many attempts. Wait %1 s (this also affects the session lock and sudo)
settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Defaults for every folder whose rule is «Default». Without the bar icon, open it from the app launcher.
form.editHint: The location and the password are not changed here (password: 󰌋 in the list).
error.passwd.failed: The password could not be changed
error.update.failed: The changes could not be saved
card.hint: This folder is locked. Type its password to open it.
unlock.useRecovery: Forgot it? Use the recovery key
error.recovery.invalid: That is not a recovery key (64 hexadecimal characters)
error.recovery.unverifiable: This folder cannot be checked yet: open it once with its password
row.lockWarning: %1 have files open: they will stop reading them.
mode.hiddenHint: It disappears from its place; open it from here.
mode.visibleHint: It stays in its place, empty; double-click it in Files to type its password.
form.readdHint: Its files are still locked on the disk. Type its password and choose where it goes.
settings.showOpenDot: Dot on the icon when one is open
settings.notifyAutoLock: Notify when a folder locks itself
settings.hideOnShare: Hide the window when sharing the screen
settings.gateTimeout: Ask for the password again after
settings.shortcutConflict: already used by something else: not applied
form.onDisk: its encrypted files stay on that disk
error.disk.missing: The disk of this folder is not connected
error.vault.missing: The encrypted files of this folder are missing
form.pathHint: Choose a folder, or type the path of a new one (e.g. ~/Documents/Private)
form.stateNew: It does not exist yet: it will be created
form.stateEmpty: It exists and is empty: it will be protected
form.notEmpty: That folder already has files. Choose an empty one, or add a new name at the end of the path
more.lockFirst: The folder is open: lock it first.
unprotect.explain: Your files will go back to a normal folder, without password, in %1. Nothing is deleted: they are checked one by one before the encryption is removed. Type the folder password.
unprotect.working: Taking your files out and checking them… it can take a while
error.unprotect.failed: It was not possible to take the files out. Nothing changed: the folder is still protected
error.unprotect.notEmpty: There are files in its place. Open the folder once so they go inside, then try again
error.unprotect.space: There is not enough free space on that disk to take the files out
error.folder.unprotecting: Its files are being taken out right now
more.forgetDesc: It leaves this list but STAYS ENCRYPTED. Your files are not deleted and cannot be seen until you add it back with its password.
more.unprotectDesc: Takes the lock off. Your files go back to a NORMAL FOLDER, without password, in the same place. Nothing is deleted. Asks for its password.
forget.confirm: «%1» will leave the list and stay encrypted. To use it again: «Add back» and its password. If you lose the password and the recovery key, it cannot be opened.
orphans.one: 1 locked folder is not in the list
orphans.many: %1 locked folders are not in the list
orphans.hint: Nothing was deleted: its files are still there, locked. Add it back with its password.
form.stateFull: It has files: they will be locked as they are, nothing is copied
form.encryptFull: Encrypt only works with a new or empty folder (otherwise your files would have to be copied). Use Hide for this one
kind.hideHint: Instant, any size. The folder is moved out of sight on the same disk: nothing is copied or changed. Not encrypted: someone who knows Linux, or this disk on another computer, could see it.
kind.encryptHint: Strong: only with the password, on any computer. For a new or empty folder; what you put inside is stored encrypted.
form.warningHide: If you forget the password, the files are still on the disk, but this window cannot open them.
more.forgetDescHide: It leaves this list but STAYS HIDDEN. Your files are not deleted and cannot be seen until you add it back with its password.
more.unprotectDescHide: Takes the lock off. The folder goes back to its place, as it was, without password. Nothing is copied or deleted. Asks for its password.
forget.confirmHide: «%1» will leave the list and stay hidden. To use it again: «Add back» and its password.
unprotect.explainHide: The folder will go back to %1 as it was, without password. Nothing is copied or deleted. Type its password.
error.path.system: That folder is used by the system. Choose another
error.hide.otherDisk: It has to stay on the disk where it is (moving it to another one would be copying it)
error.folder.missing: The folder is not in its place: it was moved or deleted outside this window
error.readd.failed: The data to check its password is missing
